name: csv-index
description: Imports any CSV with path, title, tags and license columns: one asset per row, the license text mapped to a catalog status

indexers.name: csv
indexers.description: One asset per CSV row. Columns (case-insensitive): path|file|filename|file_name (required), title|name, tags|tags_when_to_use|keywords (split on / ; , |), license|licence|license_status, credit|attribution, source_url|source|url, type (a tag, and a kind hint).

root.description: the folder relative paths are relative to (default: the CSV's folder)

import.description: full (default): hash, store and preview each file; metadata: record the paths only

limit.description: import at most this many rows (0: all)

license_default.description: the status for an empty or unknown license (default review-only)

path_column.description: the header of the path column, when it isn't detected

title_column.description: the header of the title column

tags_column.description: the header of the tags column

license_column.description: the header of the license column

tools.name: columns
tools.description: Check a CSV before importing it: its header, row count, and which column each catalog field (path, title, tags, license, credit, source, type) would come from. A problem field says what's missing.
